scenario.broken_mandate.description: Year 212. The boy emperor is dead and the Mandate of Heaven lies shattered. Six powers rise from the ruins of the Nine Provinces: the forge-lords of the north, the steppe riders of the west, the last loyalists of the Azure Court, the merchant princes of the sea, the poets of the southern lotus, and the outlaws of the Black Mountains. Only one banner will fly over Luojing.
